fields.Name: T78 - Chapters Membership Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Chapter's related Chapter Memberships can be reached from the full record form and that related rows render.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Chapters' entity from the entity tree. Select 'Silicon Valley Chapter' (or any chapter) and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full chapter form. On that form, locate the related Chapter Memberships section/tab and view it, confirming related membership rows are displayed (or a valid empty-state). Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Chapter full record form is open showing chapter detail fields
The related Chapter Memberships section/tab is visible with related rows (or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
